extracted.intended_audience: users of PARI/GP (computational number theorists, mathematicians, and programmers using the PARI library)
extracted.subtask_description: Reference manual entries for PARI/GP number-field and ray-class-group related library functions; documents syntax, arguments, flags, outputs, examples, and warnings for each routine.

rubrics_metrics.name: bnrconductorofchar
rubrics_metrics.description: Given a big ray number field bnr and a character chi (row vector on ray class group generators), returns the conductor of the character as a modulus.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax bnrconductorofchar(bnr, chi, prec). Omitted ai inputs are gzero. prec is a long. Works with bnr output from bnrclass/bnrinit.

rubrics_metrics.name: bnrdisc
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute [N, R1, D] describing degree, number of real places, and discriminant of a big ray number field L defined by a1,a2,a3 (absolute or relative depending on flag).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax bnrdisc0(a1,a2,a3,flag,prec). flag meanings: 0: absolute [degree over Q, real places, signed absolute discriminant]; 1: relative data [degree L/K, number of real places of K unramified in L, relative discriminant ideal]; 2: like 0 but returns 0 if supplied modulus is not exact conductor; 3: like 1 but conductor-checking. prec is precision.

rubrics_metrics.name: bnrdisclist
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute list of discriminants of Abelian extensions of a base number field bnf by increasing modulus norm up to bound, optionally specifying ramified archimedean places.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax bnrdisclist(bnf,bound,{arch},{flag=0}) or alternative bnrdisclist(bnf,list). Output is nested row vectors indexed by norm with each extension represented by [m,d,r,D] where m is prime-factorization of modulus (encoded), d is absolute degree, r number of real places, D factorization of absolute discriminant. flag non-zero returns all possible arch values. Decoding helpers: bnfdecodemodule, ideallist/ideallistarch. Note: internal representation uses large-vector packing (215) and encoded primes p·n^2+(f-1)·n+(j-1).

rubrics_metrics.name: bnrinit
rubrics_metrics.description: Initialize data linked to the ray class group structure corresponding to an ideal/module in a number field (bnf).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax bnrinit0(bnf,ideal,flag,prec). bnrinit(bnf,ideal,{flag=0}) is equivalent to bnrclass(bnf,ideal,flag+1). Returns bnr object used by other bnr* functions.

rubrics_metrics.name: bnrisconductor
rubrics_metrics.description: Given data representing an extension (a1,a2,a3), tests whether the represented modulus is the conductor of the extension.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax bnrisconductor(a1,a2,a3). Returns 1 if modulus is the conductor, 0 otherwise. Slightly faster than bnrconductor.

rubrics_metrics.name: bnrisprincipal / isprincipalrayall
rubrics_metrics.description: Given a bnr object and an ideal x, expresses x on ray class group generators and returns components analogous to bnfisprincipal; includes accuracy bits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Function header shows bnrisprincipal(bnr,x,{flag=1}) but library syntax provided is isprincipalrayall(bnr,x,flag). Returns 3-component vector v: v[1] components on ray class generators, v[2] gives representation on integral basis, v[3] number of bits of accuracy left in α with x=α·gxi (used to decide if increased precision is needed). If flag=0 outputs only v[1]. Flags 2 or 3 unavailable. Results are checked for correctness.

rubrics_metrics.name: bnrrootnumber
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute the Artin root number W(χ) (complex number of modulus 1) for a (possibly non-primitive) character χ given on the ray class group.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax bnrrootnumber(bnr,chi,{flag=0}). Requires generators of ray class group; set flag=1 if character is known primitive. Example provided computing root number for a character of Cl7(Q(sqrt(145))). Returns root number satisfying functional equation Λ(1−s,χ)=W(χ)Λ(s,χ).

rubrics_metrics.name: bnrstark
rubrics_metrics.description: Find a relative equation for the class field corresponding to the modulus in bnr and a congruence subgroup using Stark units (or whole ray class group if subgroup=0).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax bnrstark(bnr,subgroup,{flag=0}). Main variable of bnr must not be x; ground field and class field must be totally real and not Q. flag options: 0 reduced relative polynomial (default), 1 any relative polynomial, 2 absolute polynomial, 3 irreducible relative polynomial of the Stark unit; add 4 to try more moduli. Function tries moduli minimizing result but may fail with "Cannot find a suitable modulus in FindModule" when congruence group is product of cyclic groups; then splitting into cyclic components required.

rubrics_metrics.name: dirzetak
rubrics_metrics.description: Return first b coefficients of the Dedekind zeta function of a number field nf as Dirichlet-series coefficients.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax dirzetak(nf,b).

rubrics_metrics.name: factornf
rubrics_metrics.description: Factor a univariate polynomial x over a number field defined by polynomial t; coefficients may be in Q or the number field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax factornf(x,t). Requirement: main variable of t must be lower priority (i.e., variable number greater) than that of x. If number-field coefficients appear explicitly as polmods, the variable of these polmods must match main variable of t. Examples show allowed and disallowed variable combinations. Error behavior illustrated.

rubrics_metrics.name: ffinit
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute a monic irreducible polynomial of degree n over finite field Fp (to represent F_{p^n}).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax ffinit(p,n,{v=x}). Expects relatively small p (p < 2^31). v is variable number to use for polynomial.

rubrics_metrics.name: galoisfixedfield
rubrics_metrics.description: Given a Galois field object gal and a permutation or vector of permutations perm (elements of gal.group), compute the fixed field by automorphisms defined by perm.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax galoisfixedfield(gal,perm,{fl=0},{v=y}). flag 0 or omitted returns [P,x] with polynomial P defining fixed field and x as a root expressed as polmod; flag=1 returns only P; flag=2 returns [P,x,F] with factorization F of gal.pol over field defined by P (variable v stands for root of P and its priority must be less than gal.pol variable). P is squarefree modulo gal.p. Example given.

rubrics_metrics.name: galoisinit
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute the Galois group and auxiliary data for computing fixed fields of extension K/Q defined by pol (must be Galois with weakly super-solvable Galois group).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax galoisinit(pol,{den}). Interface experimental and subject to change. Returns an 8-component vector gal with gal.pol, gal.sign ([p,e,q] data for splitting prime), gal.roots (p-adic roots), gal matrices, gal.group (permutations), gal.gen (generators), gal.orders (relative orders). Provides properties and checks describing when G is super-solvable and structure of orders; oi are prime powers in implementation. If den present, must suit gal[5]. Feedback requested to author.

rubrics_metrics.name: galoispermtopol
rubrics_metrics.description: Given a galois field gal and a permutation element perm in gal.group, return the polynomial defining the corresponding Galois automorphism (as in nfgaloisconj).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax galoispermtopol(gal,perm). perm can be vector/matrix and function applied recursively. Note: G=galoisinit(pol); galoispermtopol(G,G[6]) is equivalent to nf-galoisconj(pol) for degree ≥2.

rubrics_metrics.name: galoissubcyclo
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute polynomial defining subfield of Q(zeta_n) fixed by subgroup H of (Z/nZ)^*; H can be given in several forms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax galoissubcyclo(n,H,{Z},{v}). If Z provided it should be znstar(n); Z used only when H is HNF matrix. v chooses variable. Helper function subcyclo shows enumerating all subfields up to order d (default n). n is a C long integer.

rubrics_metrics.name: idealadd
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute sum of two ideals x and y in number field nf; when given by Z-bases, works for any Z-modules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax idealadd(nf,x,y). Result given in Hermite Normal Form (HNF).

rubrics_metrics.name: idealaddtoone
rubrics_metrics.description: Given two coprime integral ideals x and y, find a,b with a∈x, b∈y and a+b=1; generalizes to k ideals summing to ZK.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax idealaddtoone(nf,x,{y}) or idealaddtoone0(nf,x,y) where omitted y is NULL. Alternative syntax idealaddtoone(nf,v) accepts vector of ideals summing to ZK and returns vector e with e[i] in x[i] and sum e[i]=1.

rubrics_metrics.name: idealappr
rubrics_metrics.description: Given a fractional ideal x, produce α in nf such that valuations vp(α)=vp(x) for primes where x has non-zero valuation and vp(α)≥0 elsewhere; variant accepts prime factorization and allows zero/negative exponents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax idealappr(nf,x,{flag=0}) or idealappr0(nf,x,flag). If flag non-zero, x must be prime ideal factorization output by idealfactor and algorithm differs (may yield different α than idealappr(nf,idealfactor(nf,x))).

rubrics_metrics.name: idealchinese
rubrics_metrics.description: Given prime-ideal factorization x and vector y of elements indexed by ideals in x, compute b such that vp(b−y_p)≥vp(x) for each prime in x and vp(b)≥0 for other primes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax idealchinese(nf,x,y). Implements Chinese-remainder type reconstruction at ideal level.

rubrics_metrics.name: idealcoprime
rubrics_metrics.description: Given integral ideals x and y, find β (expressed on integral basis nf[7]) such that β·y is integral and coprime to x.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax idealcoprime(nf,x). Returns β.

rubrics_metrics.name: idealdiv
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute quotient x·y^{-1} of ideals x and y in nf, result in HNF; optional flag assumes quotient is integral for speed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax idealdiv0(nf,x,y,flag). flag=0 is default; flag non-zero assumes integral quotient which can be faster when quotient norm small. Also available idealdiv(nf,x,y) (flag=0) and idealdivexact(nf,x,y) (flag=1).

rubrics_metrics.name: idealfactor
rubrics_metrics.description: Factor an ideal x into prime ideal powers in nf; output similar to factor with prime ideals represented as 5-element vectors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax idealfactor(nf,x). Prime ideals are returned in idealprimedec format.

rubrics_metrics.name: idealhnf
rubrics_metrics.description: Return Hermite Normal Form (HNF) matrix of ideal a given in any form; if b provided, assume ideal was aZK + bZK.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax idealhnf0(nf,a,{b}) where omitted b is NULL. Also available idealhermite(nf,a) when b omitted. Input a can be algebraic number (principal), ZK-system of generators, prime ideal, or Z-basis.

rubrics_metrics.name: idealintersect
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute intersection of two ideals x and y in nf; if given by Z-bases, works for any Z-modules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax idealintersect(nf,x,y). Result given in HNF.

rubrics_metrics.name: idealinv
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute inverse of ideal x in nf; returns HNF of inverse and negated Archimedean information if given.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax idealinv(nf,x).

rubrics_metrics.name: ideallist
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute list of all ideals of norm ≤ bound in nf; output is row vector with exactly bound components, each a row vector of ideals of given norm.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax ideallist0(nf,bound,{flag=4}) where bound is C long. flag's binary digits toggle: 1 include generators in idealstar, 2 output [L,U] where U vector of zinternallogs of units, 4 give only ideals not idealstar/ideallog. Default ideallist(nf,bound) corresponds to flag=0.

rubrics_metrics.name: ideallistarch
rubrics_metrics.description: Given a list of big ideals, compute vector of vectors of idealstarinit for all modules in list, adding Archimedean part arch if provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax ideallistarch0(nf,list,{arch=[]},{flag=0}). list typically from ideallist(...). flag binary digits: 1 include generators, 2 list is [L,U]. Omitted arch coded as NULL.

rubrics_metrics.name: ideallog
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute discrete logarithm of element x on generators given in bid (big ideal / idealstar data), returning integers xi with 0 ≤ xi < di such that x ≡ ∏ g_i^{x_i} (mod *I).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax ideallog(nf,x,bid). bid is big ideal from idealstar. Note: when I is a module, sign conditions on embeddings also apply. Use flag=2 in idealstar to compute necessary data (explicit generators) for ideallog.

rubrics_metrics.name: idealmin
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute a minimum of ideal x in direction vdir in nf.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax minideal(nf,x,{vdir}) -> minideal(nf,x,vdir,prec) where omitted vdir is NULL and prec optional precision.

rubrics_metrics.name: idealmul
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute product of ideals x and y in nf; result is generating set in HNF if one factor is in HNF or a prime ideal; Archimedean parts summed if present.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax idealmul(nf,x,y,{flag=0}). If flag non-zero, reduce the result using idealred. Variants: idealmul(nf,x,y) (flag=0) and idealmulred(nf,x,y,prec) (flag!=0) where prec is precision.

rubrics_metrics.name: idealnorm
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute the norm of ideal x in nf.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax idealnorm(nf,x).

rubrics_metrics.name: idealpow
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute k-th power x^k of ideal x in nf (k positive, negative, or zero); result NOT reduced (genuine k-th power) and given in HNF. Optionally reduce during powering.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax idealpow(nf,x,k,{flag=0}). If flag non-zero, reduce result using idealred; note idealpow(...,flag=1) differs from idealpow(...,flag=0) followed by reduction because reduction occurs during powering. Variants: idealpows for long k, idealpowred(nf,x,k,prec) for flag=1.

rubrics_metrics.name: idealprimedec
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute prime ideal decomposition of rational prime p in nf; returns vector of 5-component vectors [p,α,e,f,β] describing each prime above p.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax idealprimedec(nf,p). p must be prime (not checked). Representation: prime ideal = p·ZK + α·ZK with α expressed on integral basis; e ramification index, f residue degree, β vector representing element for vp^{-1}=ZK+β/pZK useful for valuations. α guaranteed valuation 1 at the prime if e>1.

rubrics_metrics.name: idealprincipal
rubrics_metrics.description: Create principal ideal generated by algebraic number x (int, rational or polmod) in nf; result is one-column matrix.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax principalideal(nf,x).

rubrics_metrics.name: idealred
rubrics_metrics.description: LLL-reduce ideal I in nf along optional direction vdir, returning HNF of LLL-reduced ideal rI/a where a chosen to make integral primitive; subtracts logarithmic embeddings if I is idele.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax ideallllred(nf,x,vdir,prec) where omitted vdir is NULL. vdir must have r1+r2 components if present. Function finds a “small” a in I (LLL pseudo-minimum along vdir). Often principal ideals yield identity matrix so can be a quick check for principality but non-trivial result doesn't prove non-principality. This is not the same as lattice LLL reduction of I because ideal operations are involved.

rubrics_metrics.name: idealstar
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute necessary data for the multiplicative group (ZK/I)^* for ideal/module I; different flags control level of explicitness of generators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax idealstar0(nf,I,{flag=1}). flag=2 returns 5-component vector w: w[1]=I, w[2]=structure of group, other components for ideallog. flag=1 (default) similar but does not compute explicit generators for cyclic components (saves time). flag=0 computes group structure as 3-component vector v: v[1] order, v[2] SNF cyclic components, v[3] generators. When I includes Archimedean embeddings (row vector with r1+ r2 components 0 or 1), non-zero entries considered real embeddings in order given by polroots. To solve discrete logs you need flag=2.

rubrics_metrics.name: idealtwoelt
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute two-element representation [a,α] of ideal x such that x = aZK + αZK using exponential-time search; optional a may be given.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax idealtwoelt0(nf,x,{a}) where omitted a is NULL. If x has at least two generators, a chosen as positive generator of x∩Z. Supplying explicit a uses asymptotically faster method but may be slower in practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: idealval
rubrics_metrics.description: Return valuation vp(x) of ideal x at prime ideal vp (format from idealprimedec).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax idealval(nf,x,vp). Result is a long integer.

rubrics_metrics.name: ideleprincipal
rubrics_metrics.description: Create principal idele generated by algebraic number x; returns [principal ideal matrix, vector of complex logarithmic embeddings].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax principalidele(nf,x). x must be integer, rational or polmod. Result is two-component vector: first principal ideal as one-column matrix, second vector with r1+r2 complex logarithmic embeddings of x.

rubrics_metrics.name: matalgtobasis
rubrics_metrics.description: Transform matrix with coefficients expressed as polmods in nf into matrix whose coefficients are expressed on the integral basis of nf.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax matalgtobasis(nf,x). Equivalent to applying nfalgtobasis to each entry but different name to avoid confusion.

rubrics_metrics.name: matbasistoalg
rubrics_metrics.description: Transform matrix with coefficients given as column vectors on integral basis into matrix with coefficients as algebraic numbers (polmods).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax matbasistoalg(nf,x). Equivalent to nfbasistoalg on each entry but separate name.

rubrics_metrics.name: modreverse / polmodrecip
rubrics_metrics.description: Given polmod A(X) modulo T(X), find reverse polmod B(X) modulo Q(X) (minimal polynomial of a) such that if θ is root of T then θ=B(α) for some root α of Q; useful for changing generating element in extensions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax polmodrecip(x) (named modreverse in header). Q must have degree equal to degree of T.

rubrics_metrics.name: newtonpoly
rubrics_metrics.description: Return vector of slopes of the Newton polygon of polynomial x with respect to prime p; components in decreasing order, vertical slopes denoted VERYBIGINT when constant coefficient zero.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax newtonpoly(x,p). VERYBIGINT is machine's max single-precision integer (2^31−1 on 32-bit, 2^63−1 on 64-bit). See Section 3.2.43 for more.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfalgtobasis / algtobasis
rubrics_metrics.description: Transform object with entries expressed as algebraic numbers in nf into entries expressed as column vectors on integral basis nf.zk (inverse of nfbasistoalg).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax algtobasis(nf,x) (header name nfalgtobasis).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfbasis
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute integral basis of number field defined by irreducible polynomial x (preferably monic) using modified round-4 algorithm by default; flags and optional p allow algorithm choice and local factor info.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax nfbasis0(x,{flag=0},{p}). Flag binary digits: 1 assume no prime-square > primelimit divides discriminant index; 2 use round-2 algorithm (sometimes faster for small degrees/coefficient sizes). flag=3 uses round-2 and outputs order maximal at small primes. If p provided as two-column matrix of partial discriminant factorization, p used to limit local computations (only factors with exponent ≥2 considered). Other convenience wrappers: nf basis(x,&d,flag,p) returns discriminant in d; base(x,&d) (flag=0), base2(x,&d) (flag=2), factoredbase(x,p,&d).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfbasistoalg / basistoalg
rubrics_metrics.description: Inverse of nfalgtobasis: transform entries expressed on integral basis into algebraic numbers (polmods).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax basistoalg(nf,x).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfdetint
rubrics_metrics.description: Given a pseudo-matrix x, compute a non-zero ideal contained in (i.e., a multiple of) the determinant of x; useful with nfhnfmod to avoid coefficient explosion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax nfdetint(nf,x).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfdisc
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute field discriminant of the number field defined by polynomial x; flags and optional p same as nfbasis controlling assumptions and algorithm (round-2 vs round-4).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax nfdiscf0(x,{flag=0},{p}) where omitted p is gzero. Flags: 1 assume no large prime-square divides index, 2 use round-2 algorithm which may be slower except for small polynomials. Alternative wrapper discf(x).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltdiv / element div
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute quotient x/y for elements x,y in nf.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax element div(nf,x,y).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltdiveuc / nf diveuc
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute algebraic integer q in nf such that components of x−qy are reasonably small (essentially round(nfeltdiv)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax nf diveuc(nf,x,y). Functionally identical to rounding quotient of nfeltdiv.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltdivmodpr / element divmodpr
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute quotient x/y modulo prime ideal pr (format from nfmodprinit) in nf.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax element divmodpr(nf,x,y,pr).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltdivrem / nf divres
rubrics_metrics.description: Given x,y in nf, return [q,r] with x = qy + r where q is algebraic integer and r has reasonably small components.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax nf divres(nf,x,y).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltmod / nf mod
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute small representative r = x − qy with q algebraic integer so that r is small; functionally equivalent to x − nfeltmul(nf,round(nfeltdiv(nf,x,y)),y).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax nf mod(nf,x,y).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltmul / element mul
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiply two elements x and y in nf.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax element mul(nf,x,y).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltmulmodpr / element mulmodpr
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiply x and y modulo prime ideal pr in nf.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax element mulmodpr(nf,x,y,pr) where pr format from nfmodprinit.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltpow / element pow
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute x^k for element x in nf and integer k (positive or negative).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax element pow(nf,x,k).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltpowmodpr / element powmodpr
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute x^k modulo prime ideal pr in nf.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax element powmodpr(nf,x,k,pr).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltreduce / element reduce
rubrics_metrics.description: Given ideal in HNF and element x, find r in nf with x−r ∈ ideal and r small (reduce element modulo ideal to small representative).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax element reduce(nf,x,ideal).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltreducemodpr / nf reducemodpr2
rubrics_metrics.description: Given element x and prime ideal pr in modpr format, compute canonical representative of class of x modulo pr.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax nf reducemodpr2(nf,x,pr).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltval / element val
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute valuation of element x at prime ideal pr (format from idealprimedec); returns long.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax element val(nf,x,pr). More efficient than converting x to principal ideal and using idealval.

rubrics_metrics.name: nffactor
rubrics_metrics.description: Factor univariate polynomial x over number field nf; x's coefficients can be scalar, polmod, polynomial or column vector in nf.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax nffactor(nf,x). Main variable of nf must have lower priority (higher variable number) than that of x. If polynomial defining number field appears explicitly in coefficients (as modulus of t_POLMOD), its variable must match main variable of x. Examples show allowed/disallowed combinations.

rubrics_metrics.name: nffactormod
rubrics_metrics.description: Factor univariate polynomial x modulo prime ideal pr in nf; x may have coefficients in nf or modulo pr (various types supported).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax nffactormod(nf,x,pr). pr must be in idealprimedec format. Same variable-priority rules as nffactor apply; if coefficients occur as polmods their variable must match t's main variable.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfgaloisapply / galoisapply
rubrics_metrics.description: Apply Galois automorphism aut (polynomial or polmod) on object x in nf; aut found via variants of nfgaloisconj.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax galoisapply(nf,aut,x). x can be element, ideal, prime ideal, or idele; other vector/matrix arguments forbidden to avoid confusion between ideals and elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfgaloisconj / galoisconj0
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute conjugates of a root r of polynomial nf[1] expressed as polynomials in r. Can work for non-Galois fields producing conjugates lying in field. Several flags control algorithm/guarantees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax galoisconj0(nf,{flag=0},{d},{prec}) and wrappers galoisconj(nf) (flag=0), galoisconj2(nf,n,prec) (flag=2, n bound on number of conjugates), galoisconj4(nf,d) (flag=4). Flag meanings: 0 default uses combination of flags 4 and 1 for complete result if nf is number field; 1 uses nfroots (requires number field); 2 uses complex approximations and integral LLL (result not guaranteed complete, may miss conjugates when huge index; increase precision if needed); 4 uses Allombert’s algorithm and permutation testing. If field is Galois with weakly super-solvable Galois group, return complete list of automorphisms, else only identity. Parameter d is multiple of least common denominator of conjugates expressed as polynomials; explanation of 'weakly super solvable' group given with practical exceptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfhilbert
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute Hilbert symbol (a,b) in nf: global symbol (omitted pr) equals 1 if x^2 − a y^2 − b z^2 has non-trivial solution in nf and −1 otherwise; local symbol if pr given.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax nf hilbert(nf,a,b,{pr}) with omitted pr coded as NULL. If pr provided compute local symbol modulo prime ideal pr (format from idealprimedec).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfhnf / nf hermite
rubrics_metrics.description: Given a pseudo-matrix (A,I), find pseudo-basis in Hermite normal form of generated module.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax nf hermite(nf,x).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfhnfmod / nf hermitemod
rubrics_metrics.description: Given pseudo-matrix (A,I) and ideal detx contained in determinant of (A,I), find pseudo-basis in HNF of module avoiding coefficient explosion by using detx.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax nf hermitemod(nf,x,detx). detx can be computed using nfdetint.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfinit
rubrics_metrics.description: Initialize number field structure nf from non-constant, preferably monic irreducible polynomial pol ∈ Z[X]; nf is technical object passed to many nf* functions and contains many useful components.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax nfinit(pol,{flag=0}). nf is row vector with 9 components including nf[1]=pol, nf[2]=[r1,r2] real/complex places, nf[3]=disc d(K), nf[4]=index [ZK:Z[θ]], nf[5] vector of matrices useful for computations. Access via member functions preferred as data organization may change.
